metadata.datasource: Kodak publication F-4017 (Feb 2016), vector paths of p7 (spectral sensitivity) and p8 (D-76 characteristic curves, 400TX 135).

tags.log_sensitivity: SHEET 380-668 nm (upper curve of p7), ASSUMED log-linear tail -0.0526 dex/nm above 668 nm; scale MEASURED so grey 0.184 -> raw 1
tags.density_curves: SHEET for log_exposure -1.74..2.04 (D-76 large tank, 7.72 min = CI 0.56, interpolated between the 6 and 8 min curves); ASSUMED flat toe below, ASSUMED straight line slope 0.473 into a ceiling of gross D 3.0 above
tags.log_exposure_anchor: SHEET ISO 400 + LIT: 0 = log10(0.8/400)+1.0 = -1.699 log lux-s
tags.base_density: SHEET level 0.286 (135 base+fog at CI 0.56), ASSUMED spectrally flat
tags.channel_density: ASSUMED: neutral silver, 1/3 per channel at every wavelength
tags.density_curves_layers: ASSUMED: three-CDF fit of the curve (max fit error 0.0047 D), no sheet data on emulsion sub-layers
